job.title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote) @ Thinkgrid Labs (Remote, IN)
job.description:
Thinkgrid Labs is at the forefront of innovation in custom software development. Our expert team of software engineers, architects, and UI/UX designers specializes in crafting bespoke web, mobile, and cloud applications, along with AI solutions and intelligent bots. Serving a diverse range of industries—including accounting, legal, healthcare, education, and real estate—we have a global client base across five continents. Our commitment to quality and passion for technological advancement drives us to push boundaries and set new standards. We’re expanding our team with smart and creative individuals who are passionate about building high-performance, user-friendly, flexible, and maintainable software.  
  
**We are hiring software engineers to work on projects for clients outside of India and so excellent oral and written communication skills are a must.**  
  
**Job Title**: Next.js Full Stack Engineer (Remote from India)  
**Location**: Remote  
**Working Hours**: 3 PM IST to 12 AM IST  
**Experience Required**: Minimum 3 years  
**Education**: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.  
  
**Who are you?**

  

* **Next.js & Node.js Proficiency:** You are experienced with Next.js 15+ and Node.js, comfortable with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript features, including async/await, classes, and destructuring.
* **Front-End Expertise:** You are skilled in React.js (React 18+), with a strong grasp of modern state management tools like Zustand, Redux, or the Context API.
* **API Development:** You are proficient in building and consuming RESTful APIs and familiar with GraphQL.
* **Database Experience:** You have hands-on experience with non-relational databases such as MongoDB (experience with MongoDB Atlas is a plus) or DynamoDB.
* **Cloud Enthusiast:** You are eager to work with cloud technologies like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with serverless architectures and microservices is a bonus.
* **Version Control & Collaboration:** You are proficient with Git and have experience in collaborative workflows using platforms like GitHub or GitLab.
* **Modern Tooling:** You are familiar with bundlers and build tools like Webpack, Vite, or Rollup, and automation tools like PM2 or Docker.
* **Quality Focused:** You are committed to writing clean, maintainable code with a focus on testing and documentation.
* **Problem Solver:** You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a knack for tackling complex challenges.
* **Team Player:** You are able to work both independently and collaboratively within an agile team environment.
* **Excellent Communicator:** You have outstanding verbal and written communication skills, essential for interfacing with international clients.
* **Passionate & Humble:** You are enthusiastic about technology and continuous learning, with a humble attitude towards teamwork and collaboration.
* **Educational Background:** You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* **Experience:** You have 3+ years of full-stack development experience in a professional setting.

**What you will be doing?**

  

* **Develop Cutting-Edge Applications:** You will build and maintain high-quality web applications using Next.js, React, and Node.js.
* **Full Ownership:** You will manage the entire software development lifecycle—from ideation and refinement of tasks to deploying code in production environments.
* **Maintain Code Quality:** You will ensure code is maintainable and scalable through comprehensive documentation and automated testing practices.
* **Optimize Performance:** You will evaluate designs for performance bottlenecks and implement solutions to enhance scalability, latency, security, and data integrity.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** You will provision and manage cloud infrastructure components, including storage solutions, web servers, and databases on platforms like AWS or Azure.
* **Code & Design Reviews:** You will engage in peer reviews to uphold high development standards and share best practices.
* **Innovate & Recommend:** You will stay abreast of emerging technologies and propose tools or methodologies to improve system performance and developer productivity.
* **Monitoring & Alerting:** You will utilize monitoring tools and logging systems to track application performance and respond to incidents.
* **Support Leadership:** You will assist engineering managers with technical decision-making processes and provide accurate estimations for project planning.  
    
  **Benefits**
* 5 day work week (unless for rare emergencies)
* Health Insurance

Job Title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer, ERP Company: Smartnode Automations Pvt Ltd

Location: Vadodara (On-site / Hybrid) Employment  
Type: Full-time Experience: 3+ years building production web applications  
Education Background: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Computer Engineering, or related discipline

About Smart Node: Smart Node builds home automation and lifestyle technology for modern Indian homes, with a growing channel partner network. Our ERP is the single platform that runs the company: production, inventory, accounts, CRM, HR, tickets, and maintenance, for both employees and channel partners. About the Role: You will own the ERP’s architecture and build it from the ground up. This is a founding engineering role: you decide how the system is structured, build the core modules, and set the standards for the team that grows around you.

Key Responsibilities:  
● Design and build a modular platform (React and Python) on PostgreSQL, with shared master data, workflows, roles and permissions, and audit logs  
● Build and ship modules in phases: Core, Inventory, Accounts, Production, CRM, Tickets, Maintenance, HRMS  
● Build two portals on one backend: Employee and Channel Partner, with role- and scope-based access  
● Integrate modules through events, so a confirmed sale triggers inventory, production, and ledger updates automatically  
● Migrate data from our existing ERP and run old and new systems in parallel before cutover  
● Use AI coding tools as a daily part of your workflow, and review, test, and take responsibility for everything that ships  
● Write clear documentation, set up CI/CD, backups, and monitoring  
● Work directly with department heads to turn real processes into software  
● Help hire and mentor future engineers

Required Skills & Attributes:  
● 3+ years building production web applications, ideally including a system of ERP or business-software complexity  
● Strong Python (FastAPI, Django, or similar) and PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, transactions, migrations)  
● Strong React (TypeScript preferred) and component-driven UI  
● Experience with REST APIs, authentication, RBAC, and multi-role systems  
● Solid grasp of data integrity: transactions, concurrency, audit trails  
● Comfortable with Docker, Linux, cloud deployment, and CI/CD  
● Demonstrated, practical use of AI-assisted development, with good judgment on when not to trust it

Good to Have:  
● Prior work on ERP, accounting, inventory, or manufacturing systems  
● Knowledge of Indian GST, TDS, or e-invoicing  
● Experience with background jobs and queues (Celery, Redis), search, and reporting  
● Mobile experience (React Native/Flutter)  
● Experience migrating data from legacy systems

Why Join Us?  
● Real ownership of a platform used daily by the whole company  
● Direct access to leadership  
● No legacy politics  
● The chance to build a team around you

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
